Hvidovre is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish National Patient Registry (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) to facilitate local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].

In the context of the report, Hvidovre's performance is tracked under Indicator 5, which focuses on the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. The municipality's specific metrics regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients are presented in a detailed municipal breakdown [^src1]. Because the available corpus only contains this single tabular mention of Hvidovre's statistical outcomes, no further relationships, distinct claims, or historical timeline events are documented for this entity.
